scenes.line1: Why split your data three ways?
scenes.say: Why do we split our data into train, validation, and test sets? And what makes cross-validation so useful?
We use the train set to teach the model, the validation set to tune its settings, and the test set to see how it performs on new data.

scenes.label: Cross-Val
scenes.sub: Rotates validation sets for robust estimates
scenes.say: Cross-validation, like five-fold, rotates which part of the data is used for validation. This gives us a more reliable measure of model performance.

scenes.question: What is data leakage?
scenes.wrong: Using all data for feature engineering
scenes.right: It's when info from outside training data sneaks into the model, making results look better than they are.
scenes.say: Watch out for data leakage. That's when information from outside the training set sneaks into your model, making it seem smarter than it really is.
